d: Indian badminton icon Saina Nehwal joins Guest in the Newsroom (GITN) for an unfiltered, powerful conversation inside The Lallantop newsroom. In this gripping episode, Saina opens up about her much-talked-about relationship with P.V. Sindhu and coach Pullela Gopichand, revealing untold truths behind the scenes. She shares the real story of her Olympic medal victory, her thoughts on the current state of Indian badminton, and the systemic challenges athletes face.
